label: Father
exampleUsage: My father cooks breakfast every morning.

label: Mother
exampleUsage: My mother walks me to school.

label: Son
meaning: A male child of a parent.

label: Daughter
meaning: A female child of a parent.

label: Grandfather
meaning: The father of your father or mother.

label: Grandmother
meaning: The mother of your father or mother.

label: Uncle
meaning: The brother of your father or mother.
exampleUsage: My uncle visits us every Sunday.

label: Auntie
meaning: The sister of your father or mother.
exampleUsage: My auntie gave me a gift.

label: Cousin
meaning: The child of your uncle or auntie.
exampleUsage: My cousin and I play together.

label: Parents
exampleUsage: My parents come to my school program.
